Priya S.: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem on missing spans / bad aggregation. Root cause: duplicate ingestion pipeline + a serializer change that dropped a span tag. Posting concise action items — pls ack and take ownership.

Priya S.: Actions: 1) Add idempotency in aggregator + regression test (owner: Ilya V.) ETA: by Fri. 2) Controlled backfill to repair rollups (owner: Omar H.) ETA: 48-72h after compute sign-off. 3) Fix serializer migration and audit other services (owner: Lina G.) ETA: next deploy. 4) Alert/runbook tweak to catch this combo pattern (owner: SRE) ETA: 2 days. 5) Weekly audit to detect recurring span drops (owner: SRE) ETA: next sprint.

Ilya V.: Ack. I'll add an idempotency key (span_id+source) and a unit test that injects duplicate events. Opening INF-3420.

Omar H.: Ack. Backfill plan: dry-run 1M rows tonight, then stream 5M chunks. Need 6 runners 03:00-09:00 PT tomorrow. Will post estimated row counts.

Lina G.: Found the serializer change — safe to hotfix. Canary deploy queued. ops-bot please kick.

ops-bot: Deploy: canary by Lina G. (deploy-2026-03-25T02:14Z)  status: queued.

sre-oncall: We'll implement the hourly sampling check comparing raw vs rollup counts per service and alarm on >1% unexplained drop. I'll add it to the runbook and schedule the audit job.

Priya S.: Please add a 1-line verification checklist to each ticket: reproduce, fix, backfill, validate, runbook. I'll close the postmortem when all items are green.

Ilya V.: Added checklist to INF-3420 and will attach regression output in PR.

Omar H.: Dry-run logs will be attached to INF-3421; estimate ~90M rows total if full run.

Priya S.: Thanks team. 10-15m sync tomorrow 08:30 PT to confirm backfill status. If blocked, ping @sre-oncall here.
